proof:
intro h Q hL hQ
have he : (↑(⟨Real.sqrt (n : ℝ), Real.sqrt_nonneg _⟩ : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) := rfl
calc
  Metric.ediam (WithLp.toLp 2 '' Q : Set (GP.Space n)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) * Metric.ediam Q := by simpa only [he] using hL.ediam_image_le Q
  _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)) * ENNReal.ofReal h := mul_le_mul_left' hQ _
  _ = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) * h) := (ENNReal.ofReal_mul (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).symm
